datasheet_identity.title: SuperMOS – SOT-23 60V BVDSS, 1.5Ω RDS(on), N-channel MOSFET

extraction_notes: Public PDF citation: ElecSuper BSS138P Rev-1.3 datasheet, www.elecsuper.com, pp. 1-7.
Transfer, output, and capacitance curves were digitized from the target-specific typical figures on pp. 4-5; points are approximate reads from plotted traces, not interpolated model values.
The transfer figure also shows a TJ = 125 °C trace; only the TJ = 25 °C trace was extracted for the required 25 °C fit condition.
RDS(on) rows are published at VGS = 10 V, ID = 0.4 A; VGS = 4.5 V, ID = 0.2 A; and VGS = 2.5 V, ID = 0.1 A. Both TYP and MAX resistance meanings are retained as separate rows.
Published capacitance MAX values are CISS = 50 pF, COSS = 22 pF, and CRSS = 5 pF at VGS = 0 V, VDS = 25 V, f = 1 MHz; the structured fields contain the TYP values.
IDSS is published as a maximum of 1.0 µA at VDS = 60 V, VGS = 0 V, TJ = 25 °C, and 100 µA at VDS = 40 V, VGS = 0 V, TJ = 125 °C; the strict schema has no IDSS field.
Gate resistance is not published as a standalone parameter; RG is omitted by the source data.
Body-diode reverse recovery trr is not published. Thermal data publishes only RθJA = 300 °C/W typical; RθJC is not published.
QG(TOT) is published as 0.65 nC typical and 1 nC maximum at VGS = 4.5 V, VDS = 25 V, ID = 0.25 A; QGS = 0.2 nC and QGD = 0.23 nC under the same conditions.

Catalog discrepancy review: the supplied PDF table gives CRSS = 2.2 pF typical at VGS = 0 V, VDS = 25 V, f = 1 MHz, while Fig. 10 shows the target-specific CRSS trace at approximately 2.5–3 pF near 30 V. Neither PDF source supports the frozen catalog seed 7.8 pF at 30 V. The 2.2e-12 F structured value is retained as the exact tabulated typical value; the plotted curve remains separately digitized with its stated approximate semantics.
